title: tephrosia purpurea
intro: Tephrosia purpurea, commonly known as 'Fever Vine', is a perennial climber plant native to the tropical regions of Africa and Asia. It has been traditionally used in various folk medicines to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders. The health benefits of Tephrosia purpurea include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimalarial properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever, alleviating pain, and preventing the spread of infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
